Description:
Ballistics of the 3UBM6 with the 3BM8 APDS-T projectile, fired from the 100mm tank gun D-10.

Tube measures 5608mm, of which the barrel is 5350mm. Length of rifling is 4630mm. Cartridge case measures ~610mm. Chamber volume is taken at 7.9 Liters.

Develops 3000 kgf/cm^2 and propels a 5.7kg projectile to 1415 m/s muzzle velocity, with 6.585 kg of charge. Charge design consists of a central beam of 18/1 Tr and 14/7 grains.

References:
- 100-мм ТАНКОВЫЕ ПУШКИ Д10-Т, Д10-ТГ и Д1О-Т2С РУКОВОДСТВО СЛУЖБЫ Ордена Трудового Красного Знамени ВОЕННОЕ ИЗДАТЕЛЬСТВО МИНИСТЕРСТВА ОБОРОНЫ СССР, МОСКВА- 1971
